fact: At a seminar reported on 29 September 2026, Customs School head Abdelhakim Abidi said AI projects are underway in the Ministry of Finance, including a chatbot at the General Directorate of Taxes and the Sinda 2 customs risk-targeting system.
title: Ministère des Finances : l’intelligence artificielle bientôt au cœur de la fiscalité et de la Douane
